header: Solar connection times in each district
lead: Every district uses the same form, law and crew size, yet the slowest takes almost three times as long as the fastest. The network report explains why.
caption: Working days from complete application to grid connection, 2026, on a scale of 0 to 100 days
note: Median of all 640 solar connections completed in 2026. Incomplete applications count from the day the missing document arrived. All bars use one 0 to 100 day scale.
